reviews.evidence: Gives sound backup, version pin, dependency, override and URL/feed guidance. Omits migration-specific checks including front-matter conversion, author/skin changes, navigation/search/comments/analytics review, built-in feed requirements and the Actions setup; the release-restriction note is vague.

Correctly says bundled skins remain switchable and font imports remain, but the example uses top-level skin: journal instead of chulapa-skin.skin. It omits the documented behavior for incomplete essential CSS and the v2.1.0 limitation.

Correctly says the palette adjustments do not guarantee whole-site accessibility and are absent from v2.1.0. Omits that primary colors are preserved, dark dim skins retain bright link/navigation accents, and fixed text colors, interaction states and content require review.
Correctly says the demo alone does not enable dark mode, but places chulapa-skin-dark inside chulapa-skin. The documented configuration uses a separate top-level chulapa-skin-dark mapping.

Correctly identifies the skins and v2.2.0 release, and does not claim AA compliance. The example uses invalid top-level skin: cerulean rather than chulapa-skin.skin. It also says original Bootswatch colors receive palette/YIQ adjustments, whereas the expected guidance is that original palettes are retained with their original contrast limitations.

Correctly explains automatic highlighting for included/rendered headings, aria-current=location, no extra setting and unchanged keyboard focus. The show_sidetoc example is conditional enablement, not a new active-highlighting option.

Correctly covers the public endpoint, production-only loading and same-domain canonical behavior, but says clearing gtag_id or analytics_id achieves a Google-only setup. Clearing both while GoatCounter is configured leaves GoatCounter as the sole configured analytics service.
Correctly uses indexcategory with ascending name order (name is the default document field), and distinguishes gallery sorting via basename and index_sort_asc.

Correctly answers deferred YouTube player loading, native code-copy functionality, immediate Enter search and floating navigation. Omits the youtube-nocookie/no-script behavior, tooltip dependency, Lunr index reuse/debounce, and v2.1.0 caveat.

Identifies the needed adapter and provider/store, but the example loads chulapa_search.js before the provider library and generated store. The expected dependency order is provider library and generated store before the adapter.
Clearly distinguishes sessionStorage-restored display state from model context and advises including relevant details in each question.

Adds several unrelated or unsupported claims, including skip-link ordering, focus restoration, 44px controls, carousel aria-live and reduced-motion behavior. Omits requested search landmarks/result announcements and the labelled Welcomments field; does not state the limits on which search providers announce results.

Covers reduced motion, pause behavior, keyboard indicators and no new setting for carousel accessibility. Omits the named play/pause button and icon fallback, hover/interactions and preference-change details; adds distracting collection image YAML advice.

Correctly says closed controls are excluded from tab order, Escape closes and restores focus, and the panel does not trap focus. Omits open-panel Tab order and focus restoration after button/overlay close.

Correctly says there is no built-in offline PWA or chatbot support and names site-specific HTTPS/baseurl/manifest/service-worker work. Omits that the current favicon manifest alone does not establish cross-browser installability or offline support, including its missing start_url/scope and 512px icon.
Advises editing an existing sample and explicitly says not to create a new file, instead of giving the requested GitHub browser workflow for creating _posts/YYYY-MM-DD-title.md.
Gives a GitHub upload workflow, relative_url image syntax, descriptive alt-text guidance and filename case verification.

Correctly directs the reader to check Actions and Settings > Pages. Adds potentially confusing distinctions between the global title and starter index.html heading, and omits a simple browser refresh check.
Correctly distinguishes PhotoSwipe's Liquid include parameter from page YAML, nolazy support in video.html and required provider/ID for hosted video.
Correctly adds a site-relative /contact/ entry to existing navbar.nav without repeating baseurl, preserves the additive approach and notes that the destination page must already exist.

limits: Twenty observations of this deployed Worker do not establish general answer accuracy, repeatability, latency distributions or human usability. All requests returned HTTP 200; this is not evidence of correctness. The uncommitted local chatbot corrections were not deployed and were not evaluated by this batch. No retries were made.
